chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:

There is no debtor whose creditor departs from him satisfied except that the creatures of the earth and the fish of the seas pray for him. And there is no debtor whose creditor departs angry while he is able to pay except that Allah, Mighty and Exalted, records against him for every day or night that he withholds him, an act of injustice.

key_terms.دَوَابُّ الْأَرْضِ: the creatures of the earth invoking blessing for the person
key_terms.رَاضِيًا: satisfied and content with how the debt matter was handled
key_terms.ظُلْمًا: an act of injustice or wrongdoing
key_terms.غَرِيمٍ: a debtor or one bound by a financial claim
key_terms.يَحْبِسُهُ: he withholds or delays payment from him

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about delaying debt repayment when one is able to pay?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the moral seriousness of settling debts properly and not delaying payment when one is able. It praises the debtor who satisfies his creditor and condemns withholding payment as ongoing injustice recorded by Allah, Mighty and Exalted.
